Subject: [Action Required] Complete Student's Pass Formalities at Offsite Enrolment (OSE), Semester 1 AY2026/2027
Preview: Dear Students ( for all full-time international students starting in Sem 1 AY2026/2027) , You are required to book and attend the ICA Offsite Enrolment (OSE) at NUS to complete your Student’s Pass formalities. This is the final step (Step 3) of your Student’s Pass application and must be completed before your digital Student’s Pass can be issued. (1) OSE Appointment Booking via ICA’s e-Appointment Portal From 1 July 2026 , appointments for OSE will be made available for booking via the ICA’s e-appointment portal: https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/eappt/ . In the dropdown menu for location, select “National University of Singapore”. What you need to do: 1. Login to ICA’s e-Service ( https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/solar/index.xhtml ) and ensure that you have completed Step 1 (acknowledge Terms & Conditions and submit your Medical Report) and Step 2 (make payment for Issuance Fee and Multiple Entry Visa Fee, if applicable) before you can book an appointment. 2. After reaching Step 3 , hold off on booking until 1 July, when “National University of Singapore” appears as a location option for OSE appointment. Ensure that payment is completed at least one day before booking your appointment. Select an appropriate timeslot that does not conflict with any other commitments. 3. Please refer to the attached OSE Guide for more details. Venue: NUS Multi-purpose Sports Hall 2 (MPSH 2). As Google Maps may be inaccurate due to ongoing construction works, you may wish to refer to the guide (click here ) to MPSH 2 Reporting Time: within your selected timeslot Documents to bring: Please refer to the checklist outlined in #(2) below and the attachments Due to the high turnout expected for the OSE, we seek your cooperation to only report during your allocated timeslot . Students who turn up early will be asked to return during their scheduled appointment. Please note that walk-ins are strictly not allowed. *Points to note* 1. Students who walk-in without an e-appointment during the OSE period will be turned away. 2. E-appointment changes are allowed up to two days before the confirmed appointment. (For example, if your appointment is on 27 July, changes must be made by 25 July). 3. Students who missed their OSE appointment are required to book another appointment to complete the formalities at ICA Services Centre after the appointment date lapsed. 4. If you have booked an appointment at ICA Services Centre instead of OSE, you may keep it. Alternatively, you may login to ICA’s e-appointment portal on 1 July to change your existing appointment to attend OSE on campus instead. (2) What to Bring for the OSE Session i. IPA Letter (PHYSICAL COPY) Print out the first page. ii. Singapore Mobile Number Attain a local mobile number that can receive text messages by purchasing an e-SIM or tourist SIM. Note: Certain tourists SIMs are data only - no local number is issued. These are not accepted for Student’s Pass. Please double confirm with the vendors that the SIM card you are purchasing comes with a local mobile number. Write the mobile number down on the top right-hand corner on the first page of your IPA letter. iii. Original Passport or travel document (PHYSICAL COPY) No photocopied or electronic versions accepted. iv. Electronic Visit Pass (e-visit Pass)/ Extension of e-visit Pass email The e-Pass is sent to your email address indicated in your SG Arrival Card upon entry to Singapore. v. Recent Colour Passport-sized Photo (PHYSICAL COPY on Matte Photo Paper) Must comply with ICA Photo Guidelines ( https://www.ica.gov.sg/photo-guidelines ). Recommended size: 35mm x 45mm (Singapore passport photo size) Background colour: plain and white vi. ~20 Singapore dollars in cash for photo booth If your photo does not meet ICA’s requirements, you will be asked to take a replacement photo at the onsite photobooth. (3) Reminder on renewal of E-visit Pass Pease take note of the validity period of your short-term visit pass (STVP) / e-visit Pass issued to your email upon entry into Singapore. If the e-appointment date is beyond the validity of your e-visit Pass, please extend your e-visit Pass at https://www.ica.gov.sg/enter-depart/extend_short_stay 14 days before the expiry of your pass. ICA will send an automated email a week before the e-visit Pass' expiry. *Important information from ICA* When filling up an extension, please state in the remarks section that: a. you are an NUS student, b. when your OSE appointment is, and c. your FIN number. If you cannot locate your e-visit Pass, please visit the following website with your Disembarkation/Embarkation (DE) Number (found in your SG Arrival Card): https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/sgarrivalcard/epassenquiry Please note that the university will be taking action against students who fail to have their Student’s Pass issued which may ultimately result in the withdrawal of their candidature. If you encounter any technical issues with the appointment booking system, please contact ICA at ica_stp1@ica.gov.sg . Lastly, should you require wheelchair-friendly routes or have any queries not addressed above, please do not hesitate to reach out to regbox60@nus.edu.sg . Thank you. NUS Student’s Pass Administration :: Office of the University Registrar :: National University of Singapore :: University Hall, Lee Kong Chian Wing, UHL #04-03, 21 Lower Kent Ridge Road, Singapore 119077 :: regbox60@nus.edu.sg (E) :: nus.edu.sg (W) :: Company Registration No: 200604346E Important: This email is confidential and may be privileged. If you are not the intended recipient, please delete it and notify us immediately; you should not copy or use it for any purpose, nor disclose its contents to any other person. Thank you.
